description:
Documentation audit (2026-04-01) found systemic naming inconsistencies:

Benchmark naming: Docs use hyphenated filenames (tpc-h.md, tpc-ds.md,
join-order.md) while the code registry uses compact/underscored names
(tpch, tpcds, joinorder). Users reading docs can't directly use the
documented names in CLI commands.

Affected benchmarks: tpc-h->tpch, tpc-ds->tpcds, tpc-di->tpcdi,
tpc-havoc->tpchavoc, tpch-skew->tpch_skew, tpc-ds-obt->tpcds_obt,
join-order->joinorder, metadata-primitives->metadata_primitives,
read-primitives->read_primitives, write-primitives->write_primitives,
transaction-primitives->transaction_primitives, tsbs-devops->tsbs_devops.

Platform naming: Docs use different conventions than registration names
(pg_duckdb.md vs registered pg-duckdb, etc.)

Resolution approach: Don't rename files (URLs would break). Instead,
ensure each doc prominently shows the CLI-usable name near the top.

verifications.command: total=$(ls docs/benchmarks/*.md | grep -v index.md | wc -l); found=$(grep -l 'CLI name' docs/benchmarks/*.md | grep -v index.md | wc -l); echo "$found/$total benchmarks have CLI name callout"; [ "$found" -eq "$total" ] && echo 'PASS' || echo 'FAIL'
verifications.description: All benchmark docs (excl. index) contain CLI name callouts
verifications.expected: 20/20 benchmarks have CLI name callout - PASS

verifications.command: grep -q 'CLI Name\|CLI name\|cli.name' docs/benchmarks/index.md && echo 'PASS: index has CLI names' || echo 'FAIL: index missing CLI names'
verifications.description: Index page has CLI name column
